headline: Collision between passenger bus, truck near Pakpattan claims 11 lives
description: <p>LAHORE: A collision between a passenger bus and truck on Thursday claimed the lives of 11 people and left 33 others injured near Pakpattan.</p> <p>Rescue 1122 said that 11 people had died in the collision.
